title: Trump votes early as Obama returns to the trail
caption: President Trump, wearing an "I Voted" sticker, talks to reporters after casting his midterm ballot early in West Palm Beach, Florida, with Melania Trump beside him. That evening, former President Barack Obama, back on the campaign trail after a first stop in Cleveland, rallied Democrats in a Detroit high-school gym, calling Trump's second term "two years of chaos and cruelty and corruption."

stories.name: Trump votes early as Obama returns to the campaign trail
facts: On Saturday, October 24, President Trump cast his midterm ballot early at the Palm Beach County Supervisor of Elections office in West Palm Beach, Florida, arriving with first lady Melania Trump.
Wearing an "I Voted" sticker, he told reporters he had voted the Republican line: "Very much so."

The same day, former President Barack Obama held his first midterm rally in Cleveland with Democratic nominees Sherrod Brown and Amy Acton, then spoke at an evening rally in a Detroit high-school gym.
Obama called Trump's second term "two years of chaos and cruelty and corruption."

artwork.alt: Poster-style illustration split diagonally between day and evening. On the sunny left, Donald Trump in a navy suit and red tie, with a small voting sticker, stands outside a low Florida elections office beside Melania Trump as two reporters hold out microphones. On the right, Barack Obama speaks from a lectern in a high-school gym with packed bleachers and a basketball hoop, facing a cheering crowd.
